settings.title: Build, if there is nothing yet
settings.body: The Launch System's staged master prompt establishes the repository, the CLAUDE.md and the checks before any feature work. It refuses to write code during discovery.

settings.title: Audit, in dependency order
settings.body: The SEO toolkit runs crawlability first, then canonicals, then indexing decisions, then metadata, then speed. Optimising a title on a URL about to be canonicalised away is wasted work.

settings.title: Find where the money leaks
settings.body: The master CRO audit produces findings with evidence and an honesty label — proven bug, strong heuristic, experiment opportunity, or insufficient data — ranked by impact and confidence over effort.

settings.question: Is anything in the bundle exclusive to it?
settings.answer: No. It is the same three products sold on their own pages, at the same versions, delivered as three downloads on one order. There is no bundle-only file, and buying separately later loses you nothing but the difference in price.

settings.question: How is it delivered?
settings.answer: Three ZIP archives, available immediately after purchase. Each contains plain Markdown you can read in any editor, with or without Claude Code.

settings.question: Do I need all three?
settings.answer: Probably not today. Most people have one of the three problems right now. The bundle is worth it if you expect to meet the other two — which most sites do, in the order build, rank, convert. If you only have one problem, buy the one product.

settings.question: What does the licence cover?
settings.answer: One person, unlimited projects, including client work. The bundle does not change that: it is still one person, now with three products. It is not a team or company licence, and the files are not to be redistributed.

settings.question: Do the three overlap?
settings.answer: Deliberately very little. The Launch System has one conversion file; the SEO toolkit has none. Where the subjects touch — performance appears in both the SEO and conversion toolkits — each says where it stops and which of the others carries on.

settings.question: Is there a subscription or an update fee?
settings.answer: Neither. One payment, and the files are yours. Updates within a major version are free; there is no recurring charge and nothing to cancel.

settings.question: Will it write the fixes for me?
settings.answer: The audits deliberately will not. They run in a mode that changes nothing and produces findings, because an audit whose findings disappear into a commit leaves you with a diff and no way to tell which finding was real. Separate workflows implement, once you have decided what to do.

settings.question: Can I get a refund?
settings.answer: Because these are digital downloads delivered instantly, sales are final. That is stated here before purchase rather than in the confirmation email afterwards. The full terms are in the refund policy.

settings.heading: And after launch?
settings.body: The three systems here take a site from nothing to live, found and converting. The Claude Code Website Operations & Maintenance System is the fourth stage — monitoring, security, backups, updates, deployment gates, incident playbooks and monthly reporting — and it is the one you will use every week for as long as the site exists.
